main_topics.reason: The user came to ask whether changing to a different maker of the same dose was something to worry about and what to do.
The user asked why to wait six to eight weeks, whether an earlier TSH result counted, and when to test again.
The user said they would prefer one brand and discussed asking the doctor and pharmacy whether this could be arranged.
The user said the pharmacy switched brands without explaining the change, which left them annoyed.
The user asked what to watch for and said coldness and tiredness are signs they notice quickly.

output.summary: The user asked whether a pharmacy’s switch to a different maker of the same levothyroxine dose required action. The assistant explained that the user could keep their routine consistent, watch for symptoms, arrange a TSH test six to eight weeks after the switch, and ask about staying on one brand; the user said this was a clear plan and exactly the answer they wanted.
